name: Ingoku Mside
source:
Two protagonists "Takahiro" and "Kouta" are just like any other young person but,
the two of them have a certain issue.
That is, that they are full blown masochists that love to be dominated by women...
Up until now, they would satisfy their desires by heading off to an SM club but, recently they have start to feel unsatisfied.
They don't want the domination to be part of roleplay, they want it to be REAL.
They want to ravaged and experience what it's really like to be r*ped-----
Carrying this issue, they continued to lead unfulfilling lives...
Until, a post on a certain SNS changed their lives forever.

"Slave Recruitment"
A simple title and a post containing nothing more than a method of contact.
They pounced upon the opportunity without a second thought.
And then their fateful day arrived.
What was waiting for them at the specified destination point was a bunch of women with stun-guns...
Without a moments notice they were zapped unconscious, thrown into and taken away in the trunk of a car.
When they woke up the next day....

"Welcome, to the prison of lust-----"
Before them lay a expanse where men are slaves, humiliated and used by women as sexual objects. In the prison of lust, men are not "human" and of course, have no human rights.
They must serve and their female overlords, reveling the never ending abuse.
A place, like hell on earth... but not for our two protagonists, no.
This is what they always wanted. To drown in the pleasure of being dominated by women.

translation:
两位主人公“隆弘”和“康太”与其他年轻人没什么不同，但他们有一个特殊问题。
也就是说，他们是彻头彻尾的受虐狂，喜欢被女性支配……

直到现在，他们都会去SM俱乐部满足欲望，但最近开始感到不满足。
他们不想让支配成为角色扮演，而是想要真实的支配。
他们想被蹂躏，体验真正被强奸的感觉——

怀着这个问题，他们继续过着毫无满足感的生活……
直到某个SNS上的帖子永远改变了他们的人生。

“奴隶招募”

一个简单的标题，帖子里只有联系方式。
他们毫不犹豫地抓住机会。
命运之日到来时，指定地点等待他们的是一群持电击枪的女人……
他们毫无防备地被电晕，塞进汽车后备箱带走。
第二天醒来时……

“欢迎来到欲望监狱——”

眼前是一片男人作为奴隶、被女人羞辱并当作性物品使用的空间。在欲望监狱里，男人不是“人”，自然也没有人权。
他们必须服侍女性统治者，沉溺于无止境的虐待。
这是人间地狱般的地方……但对两位主人公来说并不是。
这正是他们一直渴望的：沉浸在被女人支配的快感中。
